name: Stellar Drift knocks enemies back with Way of the Goddess (#10998)
contract: Stellar Drift 800501 puts a 3000 ms periodic trigger aura (effect 0, amplitude 3000) on the caster whose single tick at expiry casts the knockback 800500, and slows nearby enemies with 802773.

Its trigger is a knockback, so the caster's own aura counted as harmful, and the Starcaller passive Way of the Goddess 801976 ('Reduces the duration of harmful magic effects on you by 25%', SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL Magic -25) cut it to 2250 ms (captured in game for #10998). The aura expired before its 3000 ms tick, so the slow landed and the knockback never did.
Expected: effect 0 is marked positive, Way of the Goddess leaves the caster's aura at 3000 ms, and a Defias Cutpurse 3 yd away is still unmoved 1.5 s in and thrown at least 15 yd after the slow.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

DISCRIMINATING: with Way of the Goddess the knockback still throws the creature at least 15 yards
